story.title: Our Story
story.p1: It all started in 2014, in a finance office in Istanbul. Over years as a professional trader, our founder noticed a harsh reality: Individual investors were fighting at a serious disadvantage against institutional players. While hedge funds and investment banks used million-dollar algorithmic systems, retail traders were still battling with traditional indicators.
story.p2: We set out to eliminate this inequality. We collected 49 million rows of NASDAQ-100 and XAU/USD data from 2000 to present. After 9 months of intensive training, ForexsAi was born — an AI platform that brings institutional-grade analysis power to everyone.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To create equal opportunity in financial markets. Using artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, we provide individual investors with institutional-level analysis tools and guide them toward more informed decisions.

sentiment.desc: Instead of complex data, LLM (Large Language Model) gives you a market summary: 'Bullish market prevailing, buyers are strong'. It interprets news flow and technical data as 'Neutral', 'Positive', or 'Negative'.

rhythm.title: Rhythm Detector
